The '''Talon Cutter''' was a model of personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
